title: Introduction and overview — Dassault Rafale
description: Introduction and overview of the Dassault Rafale: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The Dassault Rafale is a twin-engine multirole fighter built by Dassault Aviation, entering French service in 2001. Designed as an omnirole aircraft for air force and naval carrier use, it has won export orders from Egypt, India, Qatar, Greece, and others. Over 260 have been built. Baseline facts: Twin-engine omnirole fighter; French service from 2001; 260+ built by Dassault; carrier-capable..
